ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Roopa Screen IPO at a median premium of ₹30 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹0 to ₹32. The median has climbed ₹22 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 106.7% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹64 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 46.88%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 5.92× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (32/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Roopa Screen IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep, with listing expected 1 Oct. For the Roopa Screen IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹19.20 Cr. See also Roopa Screen IPO subscription status and Roopa Screen IPO allotment status. This Roopa Screen IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Roopa Screen IPO allotment?

faq.q: What are Moneyview's revenue and profit?

These are restated figures from the company's own Red Herring Prospectus, page 143 — the SEBI-mandated disclosure filed with the exchange.

ipos.prose:
The Moneyview IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹14 today, drawn from 7 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹13 to ₹14. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹34 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 41.18%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 6.22× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (82/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Moneyview IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep, with listing expected 1 Oct. For the Moneyview IPO, one lot is 441 shares and the issue size is ₹1,091.68 Cr. See also Moneyview IPO subscription status and Moneyview IPO allotment status. This Moneyview IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Orient Cables IPO grey market premium is ₹80 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹70 and ₹87. That is ₹7 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 21.2% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹272 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 29.41%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.06× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (73/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Orient Cables IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the Orient Cables IPO, one lot is 55 shares and the issue size is ₹552.00 Cr. See also Orient Cables IPO subscription status and Orient Cables IPO allotment status. This Orient Cables IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

allotment_faq.a: The Orient Cables IPO is subscribed 2.06 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the German Green Steel IPO at a median premium of ₹28 — the midpoint of 7 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹20 to ₹30. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 35.7% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹139 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 20.14%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.82× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (68/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the German Green Steel IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the German Green Steel IPO, one lot is 107 shares and the issue size is ₹303.90 Cr. See also German Green Steel IPO subscription status and German Green Steel IPO allotment status. This German Green Steel IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO at a median premium of ₹16 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹15 to ₹16. That is ₹0.5 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹110, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 14.55% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.26× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (78/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹42.44 Cr. See also Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO subscription status and Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment status. This Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

₹110 के ऊपरी प्राइस बैंड के मुक़ाबले यह प्रीमियम लगभग 14.55% के अनुमानित लिस्टिंग लाभ की ओर इशारा करता है — यह बाज़ार की उम्मीद है, कोई भविष्यवाणी नहीं। माँग की तरफ़ देखें तो यह इश्यू कुल 0.26 गुना सब्सक्राइब हो चुका है। बोली अभी खुली है (25-29 Sep)। Bench Mark Infotech Services आईपीओ की अलॉटमेंट तारीख़ 30 Sep है, और लिस्टिंग 5 Oct को अपेक्षित है। यह एक एसएमई इश्यू है, इसलिए सावधानी ज़्यादा ज़रूरी है: एसएमई का ग्रे मार्केट पतला होता है, हमारे आँकड़ों में ट्रैकरों का मतभेद यहीं सबसे ज़्यादा रहता है, और छोटे बाज़ार को प्रभावित करना आसान होता है।

ipos.prose:
The A-One Steels IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹51 today, drawn from 7 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹38 to ₹54. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Trackers differ by about 31.4% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹405 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 12.59%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.42× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (73/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the A-One Steels IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep, with listing expected 1 Oct. For the A-One Steels IPO, one lot is 37 shares and the issue size is ₹405 Cr. See also A-One Steels IPO subscription status and A-One Steels IPO allotment status. This A-One Steels IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Dudani Retail IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹3 today, drawn from 6 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹3 to ₹3. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Measured off the ₹29 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 10.34%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.08× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (82/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Dudani Retail IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the Dudani Retail IPO, one lot is 4000 shares and the issue size is ₹10.54 Cr. See also Dudani Retail IPO subscription status and Dudani Retail IPO allotment status. This Dudani Retail IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Acevector IPO grey market premium is ₹2 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹2 and ₹3. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 50% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹32 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 6.25%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.24× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (66/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Acevector IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the Acevector IPO, one lot is 468 shares and the issue size is ₹420.00 Cr. See also Acevector IPO subscription status and Acevector IPO allotment status. This Acevector IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Runwal Enterprises IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹16 today, drawn from 7 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹14 to ₹30. The median has slipped ₹11 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 100% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹305 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 5.25%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.44× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (25-29 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (60/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep, with listing expected 5 Oct. For the Runwal Enterprises IPO, one lot is 49 shares and the issue size is ₹500.00 Cr. See also Runwal Enterprises IPO subscription status and Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment status. This Runwal Enterprises IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Green Asia Impex IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 5 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.02× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (24-28 Sep) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Green Asia Impex IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 29 Sep, with listing expected 1 Oct. For the Green Asia Impex IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹60.10 Cr. See also Green Asia Impex IPO subscription status and Green Asia Impex IPO allotment status. This Green Asia Impex IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Robokidz Eduventures IPO at a median premium of ₹76.5 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹65 to ₹80. The median has slipped ₹0.5 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 19.6% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹106 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 72.17%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 833.56× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (76/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 24 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Robokidz Eduventures IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹31.09 Cr. See also Robokidz Eduventures IPO subscription status and Robokidz Eduventures IPO allotment status. This Robokidz Eduventures IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Adroit Industries IPO at a median premium of ₹47 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹38 to ₹53. The median has climbed ₹9 since yesterday, a sign of strengthening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 31.9% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹134 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 35.07%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 176.85× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (70/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Adroit Industries IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep. For the Adroit Industries IPO, one lot is 111 shares and the issue size is ₹150.71 Cr. See also Adroit Industries IPO subscription status and Adroit Industries IPO allotment status. This Adroit Industries IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the ArMee Infotech IPO at a median premium of ₹8 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹5 to ₹10. The median has slipped ₹7 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 62.5% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹375 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 2.13%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.62× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (53/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the ArMee Infotech IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep. For the ArMee Infotech IPO, one lot is 40 shares and the issue size is 300.00 Cr. See also ArMee Infotech IPO subscription status and ArMee Infotech IPO allotment status. This ArMee Infotech IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Coreintegra Consulting IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Coreintegra Consulting IPO is subscribed 1.4 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Coreintegra Consulting IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Coreintegra Consulting IPO bidding window is 23-25 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the Coreintegra Consulting IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the Coreintegra Consulting IPO is 1600.0 shares, at a price band of Rs 78.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Coreintegra Consulting IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Coreintegra Consulting IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the Coreintegra Consulting IPO is expected on 28 Sep, with listing expected on 30 Sep. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Coreintegra Consulting IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Coreintegra Consulting IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Coreintegra Consulting IPO is subscribed 1.4 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

ipos.prose:
No Unitec Fibres IPO grey market premium has been reported yet — all 3 trackers we monitor currently quote ₹0, which usually means grey-market activity simply hasn't started. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 3.92× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (56/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Unitec Fibres IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep. For the Unitec Fibres IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹34.47 Cr. See also Unitec Fibres IPO subscription status and Unitec Fibres IPO allotment status. This Unitec Fibres IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the Liqvd Digital IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The Liqvd Digital IPO is subscribed 5.08 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the Liqvd Digital IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The Liqvd Digital IPO bidding window is 23-25 Sep. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the Liqvd Digital IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the Liqvd Digital IPO is 2000 shares, at a price band of Rs 54.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get Liqvd Digital IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the Liqvd Digital IPO allotment date?

allotment_faq.q: How do I check Liqvd Digital IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the Liqvd Digital IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The Liqvd Digital IPO is subscribed 5.08 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

No Pooja Logistics IPO grey market premium has been reported yet — all 4 trackers we monitor currently quote ₹0, which usually means grey-market activity simply hasn't started. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 3.19× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (61/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the Pooja Logistics IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 28 Sep, with listing expected 30 Sep. For the Pooja Logistics IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹44.23 Cr. See also Pooja Logistics IPO subscription status and Pooja Logistics IPO allotment status. This Pooja Logistics IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.79× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (56/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Vivekanand Cotspin IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 24 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Vivekanand Cotspin IPO subscription status and Vivekanand Cotspin IPO allotment status. This Vivekanand Cotspin IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
